card.name: Word just before "your" or "you"
card.fires_on: The word "to" (also "so", "help", "you") right before an expected "your" or "you", mostly in web calls to action like "delivered direct to your inbox".

modes.label: Delivery to your inbox
modes.description: "to" after "delivered" or "delivered direct" in newsletter sign-up lines, where "your inbox" comes next.
modes.example: Get the latest health and medical information delivered direct<< to>> your inbox FREE!

modes.label: Other words before you/your
modes.description: Linking words such as "so" or "help" that are followed by "you" in marketing or instructional text.
modes.example: This means no downtime,<< so>> you and your friends can always play

card.writes: It pushes the model toward "your" and "you" next and away from words about other people or owners.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "your" or "you", as in "delivered to your inbox".
